headerDisplay: Publishes customized buttons of SwitchBot virtual IR remotes as Matter on/off outlets. Turning one on sends the button once; it falls back to off after a moment. Requires Matter on this plugin's child bridge.

credentialsFile.title: Credentials File
credentialsFile.description: JSON file with the SwitchBot OpenAPI "token" and "secret". Must be readable by the owner only (chmod 600). Kept out of config.json on purpose.

button.title: Button Name
button.description: Exactly as registered in the SwitchBot app.

name.title: Matter Name
name.description: Name shown in the controller (max 32 bytes).
